idea-plugin.name: Figma to Backend
idea-plugin.description:
A PyCharm plugin that bridges the gap between Figma frontend designs and backend development.

Features:
  • Direct Figma integration within PyCharm through a dedicated tool window
  • Design-to-code generation from Figma designs
  • Intelligent code placement in your project structure
  • Production-ready frontend code generation (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript)

Usage:
  1. Open the Figma tool window (View -> Tool Windows -> Figma)
  2. Enter your Figma access token
  3. Browse and select your Figma design
  4. Generate frontend code directly into your PyCharm project

action.description: Generate frontend code from selected Figma design
